extraction.project_name: Development of Extended Producers Responsibility (EPR) Portal under E-Waste (Management) Rules 2022
extraction.summary: The requirement document asks for a national portal where producers, recyclers and refurbishers of electronic goods register, report their e-waste data and obtain or trade EPR certificates, with regulators approving and auditing them. It also asks for dashboards and reports, a mobile app with a chatbot, and five years of maintenance after a one-year warranty, hosted at the National Informatics Centre.
